description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DatabaseStore', which implements the 'Store' interface. The class provides a method 'flush' that persists monitor metrics into a database by constructing and executing an SQL insert statement. The file includes licensing and header comments related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM, and references an external Store interface file.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements the Store interface to persist monitor metrics into a database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Constructs and executes an SQL INSERT statement to save monitor metrics into the database.
